content.title: Dine Brands (DIN): Net Profit Margin Drops to 5.3%, Challenging Bullish Margin Narratives
content.summary: Dine Brands Global (DIN) is projecting revenue growth of just 1.5% per year, sharply trailing the broader US market’s 10.5% annual estimate. The company’s net profit margin stands at 5.3%, down from 10.9% a year ago, with negative earnings growth over the past twelve months. Currently trading at $25.46, well below its estimated fair value, Dine Brands also posts a price-to-earnings ratio of 8.8x. This makes it notably cheaper than both peer and industry averages.
